$comment: Design v3.1 §1 — the registry of every TOP-LEVEL entry that appears under the daemon state home (crewStateHome(): the --db parent, ~/.wicked-crew by default). wicked-core embeds this file (src/state_home.rs, include_str!) to build the worker Read fence: one deny rule per entry, with the resolved skills/snapshots/<gen>/ the ONLY non-denied path. At every launch that opens the fence, core LISTS the state home's top-level entries (and skills/'s) and REFUSES the launch, naming the entry, if one is not classified here — fail closed, never widen. No runtime enumeration ever BUILDS a rule; this list is static. crew mirrors this file at packages/crew/tests/fixtures/state-home-subtrees.json, and its tests/state-home-subtrees.test.ts asserts (a) every join(<state home>, …) in crew's src/ names an entry here and (b) a booted daemon creates nothing outside it. `name` is an exact top-level name; `prefix` covers a file and its sidecars (core.db, core.db-wal, core.db.events, …). `worker_read` is prose for the reader; the skills entry's `read_slot` and `denied_children` are the machine-readable half core enforces. Residual (documented): a top-level entry created under the state home WHILE a session is running is fenced at the next launch, not mid-session — crew is the only writer of that directory; sibling immutable generations under skills/snapshots/ are readable until crew reaps them (a static rule cannot deny every sibling but the handed one without enumeration).

entries.name: skills
entries.worker_read: snapshots/<gen>/ (the resolved WICKED_SKILLS_SNAPSHOT) only; baseline/, effective/, manifest.json, current, .uv-cache/, snapshots/.staging-*, snapshots/.tmp-* denied

entries.name: project-graphs
entries.worker_read: none (a run's project graph is handed to the engine by explicit dbPath, not read through the state home)

entries.name: interactive-chat-ledger.json
entries.source: src/interactive/chat-events.ts — join(defaultStateDir(), 'interactive-chat-ledger.json'); swept via src/api/server.ts crewStateDir

entries.name: interactive-chats
entries.worker_read: none (a run's inbox is handed to the engine as an explicit extra write root)

entries.source: src/cli/index.ts — join(stateHomeOfDb(dbPath), 'bus.db') (wicked-bus SQLite: bus.db, bus.db-wal, bus.db-shm)

src/cli/index.ts — join(stateHome(), 'core.db') is the default --db; wicked-core writes the file and its sidecars: SQLite -wal/-shm, `<db>.events/` (event_log.rs), `<db>.mem*` and `<db>.knowledge*` (actor.rs SIDECAR_SUFFIXES)
the sanctioned launch redirects the daemon's stdout to <state home>/daemon-stdout.log (operating playbook; src/api/diagnostics.ts names it) — crew itself never writes it
